about: Port Alberni is a city at the head of Alberni Inlet on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, inland from the west-coast surf beaches toward Ucluelet and Tofino. Forestry harbour heritage, inlet scenery, and a valley setting between mountain ranges define the Alberni Valley’s main centre. About 18,000 people live in Port Alberni.
seoSummary: Vancouver Island city at the head of Alberni Inlet—forestry harbour and gateway toward Pacific Rim beaches.
